title: VirtualBox virtual machines
whyItMatters: Each virtual machine is a full disk image: an old Windows install, a work environment or a test system with its own accounts and files. Deleting the VM from the list does not delete the image.
source: VirtualBox manual, where VirtualBox stores its files: the default machine folder on Linux is ~/VirtualBox VMs: https://www.virtualbox.org/manual/ch10.html
notes: The global VM list, snapshots config and settings are in ~/.config/VirtualBox, which this rule does not count. The machine folder can be changed per VM, and some VMs live on other drives.
